sources.entry: trl - A library for post-training transformer language models with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and other trainers.

summary.one_liner: TRL (Transformers Reinforcement Learning) is a Hugging Face library for post-training foundation language models with SFT, GRPO, DPO, KTO, and reward-model training.
summary.what_it_does: TRL provides dedicated trainer classes, including SFTTrainer, GRPOTrainer, DPOTrainer, KTOTrainer, and RewardTrainer, each described as a light wrapper around the 🤗 Transformers trainer. The README says it scales from a single GPU to multi-node clusters via 🤗 Accelerate using DDP, DeepSpeed ZeRO, and FSDP. It integrates with 🤗 PEFT for quantization and LoRA/QLoRA on modest hardware, and with 🦥 Unsloth for optimized kernels. A command-line interface (`trl sft`, `trl dpo`, `trl kto`) allows fine-tuning without writing code. An experimental area under `trl.experimental` holds unstable features that may change without notice.
use_cases: aligning models with human preference data
training with GRPO reinforcement learning and math reward functions
fine-tuning models from binary desirable/undesirable feedback
running LoRA or QLoRA fine-tuning on large models with limited hardware
scaling training across multi-GPU or multi-node clusters
notable: Covers SFT, GRPO, DPO, KTO, and reward-model training in one library with a consistent trainer API
Command-line interface for SFT, DPO, and KTO without code
Runs on AMD Instinct GPUs via ROCm and on AWS Trainium via TorchNeuron, per the README's What's New section
Experimental namespace for fast-moving features, clearly separated from stable API
caveats: Experimental features under trl.experimental may change or be removed in any release without notice
accuracy_reward requires the optional math-verify extra installed separately
Installing from source is needed for unreleased features
